title: August and the Visitor
author: August Quintana
blurb: Ada Dunmore, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
